children: Qualcomm stock was surging on Tuesday after the chip maker said it would partner with Amazon to build data-center infrastructure, including chips and optical networking products.
Shares of Qualcomm jumped 8.3% to $182.82 ahead of the opening bell. Amazon stock was 0.7% lower. Futures tracking the S&P 500 slid 0.1% as investors fretted about rising oil prices.
